item.title: Dr wondertainment’s instant clown costume (seeking Green Light)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Informative

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is simply cheap plastic packaging held a single red noes, the cardboard label said ‘Dr. Wondertainment’s instant clown costume’ on it. There were no other writing or label on this packaging, no obvious anomalous properties seem to be apparent of the object until placed upon a person.

Central Narrative: Their skin seemed to be rubber now and cloths have morphed to appear goofy and in character of a clown, the face resembles that of a Halloween clown mask creepy and eerie as you stare into its lifeless rubber eyes, and fake rubber teeth, the noes once placed there cannot be removed and causes individuals to wonder mindlessly around room, cities and forests, grabbing onto any item then can use as weapon including knives, hammers, guns and any other blunt object within grasp, so far these entities have only stood menacingly out of view avoiding human contact walking away when approached never using their threatening objects for harmful reasons, and once morning arrives, they disappear.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: upon observation of a deceased victim of SCP-XXXX they find that the noes overtakes a person, turning skin into that of a cheap Halloween mask rubber, their cloths had been effected as well being overtaken by light fabrics like a cheap costume binding to not only frantic but the skin as well much like it was stitching together

Additional Notes: each face is unique and terrifying, no instant of this SCP has taken a life, but all instances have perished either due to fearful reactions of bystanders shooting in self defense, or long term starvation due to the fact an infected individuals loses the will and ability to eat or drink, more research to be conducted.
